sections.title: Engineering Product Management from Theory to Practice
sections.description: This course introduces up to 50 undergraduate and graduate SEAS students to the principles and practice of Product Management. As a 1 CU course, it provides a deep dive into product development for technology-intensive startups and large corporations. Students will explore product and market strategy, apply key Product Management tools and frameworks, and engage in real-world applications. Upon completion, students will gain a thorough understanding of the role of product managers and the ability to develop and launch successful products. This course qualifies for the Engineering Entrepreneurship Minor and Graduate Certificate. Second year students and above are permitted to enroll.
